messages:
incident-bot: ALERT fired: gpu_memory_pressure on pool gpu-pool-12 (region-us-west-2). severity=critical. metric=gpu.mem.util > 92% for 30s. traces: /ops/alerts/1766123344

pagerduty: PagerDuty incident PD-78431 triggered (auto-escalation). initial page to @Akumar. link: https://pd.example.com/incidents/PD-78431

Akumar: acked the page, jumping in. starting quick triage. /cc @Maria @Chao

Maria: seeing repeated cudaAlloc failures in the logs for model: redwood-7b-qa-quant. sample: 
```
E tensorflow: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
model=redwood-7b-qa-quant shard=3 alloc=1.2G timestamp=1766123339
```

Chao: confirming kvcache eviction rate spiked ~2x 60s ago. looks like a hot prefix causing persistent KV resident growth. PS: auto-shedder did not trigger because latency SLO path flagged prioritize throughput.

Akumar: temporarily draining new requests to that pool. running command: 
```
redwoodctl pool scale --pool gpu-pool-12 --target 0.6
```

Ops Shift: I flipped routing to fallback pool gpu-cpu-fallback for new sessions, customers might see increased latency (~800-1200ms). logged the change: route-id=rt-9982.

Maria: are any customer-facing APIs degraded? console shows 502 spikes on /v1/generate for a subset of hosts served by gpu-pool-12. correlating with PD alert window.

Akumar: posting quick impact summary to status: some real-time chat customers in us-west experiencing elevated latency and transient 502s. estimated affected sessions ~0.8% of global. will update within 15m.

InfraBot: note: node gpu-12-03 reported CUDA error: 700 (out of memory) and was auto-evicted by k8s. Pod restarted 2x. kernel dmesg excerpt: 
```
[1766123340.123] NVRM: GPU at 0000:3b:00.0: Xid (PCI SIGSEGV) 69
[1766123341.456] device gpu-12-03: cuda_alloc failed, available=128MB, requested=1.2GB
```

Chao: working on a hot-fix: reduce batch size and enable aggressive prefix cache TTL for the redwood-7b-qa-quant variant. patch: 
```
PATCH: model-config/redwood-7b-qa-quant.yaml
batching: max_batch_tokens: 1024 -> 512
kv_cache: ttl_seconds: 3600 -> 300
```
Applying now via canary to one replica.

Akumar: canary applied to replica r-gpu-12-03-canary. Observing memory drop on that replica within 45s. Good sign.

Maria: created short eval to ensure outputs unchanged for typical prompts (smoke check). running 50 samples against canary.

Akumar: PD status updated: acknowledged -> investigating. escalation paused.

Ops Shift: will keep fallback routing in place. for mitigation we should also consider preemptive node rotation in pool to defragment GPU memory across pods. scheduling rolling restarts after stabilization.

Chao: can confirm canary passed smoke checks (50/50 exact-match except for minor whitespace diffs). promoting config to pool. will monitor eviction count.

Akumar: promoted config to pool. watching for recurrence. set alert threshold to 95% to reduce noisy paging while we stabilize. added a ticket: TKT-4123 to follow up on model memory regression and possible quantization profile mismatch.

Maria: drafting customer-facing summary for status page. note: no persisted data loss, only transient request failures for a small subset. ETA for full recovery: 30-60m depending on node stabilization.

incident-bot: PD incident PD-78431 status: INVESTIGATING -> MITIGATED (auto-comment). action: routing fallback + canary config deploy + pool scaling reduced pressure.

Akumar: handing off to Ops Shift for monitoring and postmortem. tagging @Chao for follow-up on kv cache behavior. thanks all. :thumbsup:

Ops Shift: acknowledged handoff. will keep watch and update when all nodes stable. creating postmortem stub: /docs/incidents/PD-78431-postmortem

Maria: quick note for the postmortem: include timeline, exact config diffs, affected customer list, and cost impact (extra CPU-fallback use).

Chao: scheduling a deeper model memory profile run for next week to rule out quantization edge-case.

Akumar: closing thread here, will reopen if we see re-escalation.
